usage: The word 燒 (siu1) is commonly used to describe food that is roasted or grilled, especially meats.
It is often combined with the name of the food to specify the cooking method, like 燒鴨 (siu1 ngap3) for roasted duck.
燒 can appear as a verb or adjective depending on context, but primarily it refers to the cooking style of roasting.
It frequently shows up on restaurant menus to indicate dishes cooked over an open flame or oven.
